source_findings.quantity: Histogram of absolute measured-depth minus range to the present reconstructed vertex, selected by front-facing normal, nonzero depth and truncation. Several vertices can consume the same frame/pixel.
source_findings.consequence: Its median scale is a conditional reconstruction discrepancy, not an identified independent sensor-noise variance; histogram count is not automatically independent sample count.

source_findings.quantity: Fewer than1000 histogram entries disables the local bin; nearest populated distance bin supplies scale.
source_findings.consequence: This is sparse-bin protection from the original mechanism; weakening it needs a predictive distribution for the same selected residual, not an arbitrary n/(n+1000) interpolation.

source_findings.quantity: max(half_voxel,sigma), independent depth-scale estimator and positive historical scale envelope.
source_findings.consequence: These mechanisms protect coarse geometry and displaced old surfaces. Replacing max with independent-error convolution or replacing envelope with scale difference is not justified by the stored residual summary.

genealogy.R07: All vertices avoid mesh-order-dependent sub-sampling. Wrong/occluded surface correspondences inflated noise and retained ghosts. min_bin_samples1000 has no derivation in historical record.
genealogy.R08: Half-voxel floor protects synthetic coarse background surfaces; single-ray1sigma and multi-view votes compensate each other. Historical measured improvements must not be removed for a prettier formula.
genealogy.R13_R14: Scale is measured by the existing fixed near/far remeasurement estimator; saved history lacks per-face acquisition scale, so its conservative envelope cannot be narrowed by assuming known provenance.

executed_identifiability_check.conclusion: Even the untruncated residual variance would not identify independent sensor and mesh components; median, absolute folding and selection do not restore that missing information. These cases are analytic diagnostics, not measured scene statistics.

joint_likelihood_requirement.selected_residual: If A is the existing normal/depth/truncation acceptance event, use p(residual | H,A)=p(residual,A | H)/P(A | H); raw unselected density cannot replace it silently.
joint_likelihood_requirement.dependence: Build geometry from the same depth once; do not treat reconstructed geometry and its depth as independent observations or add the same reconstruction uncertainty again.
joint_likelihood_requirement.frozen_contract: Preserve all existing frames, vertex samples, distance bins, histogram resolution, scale grid, scoring and input protocol. No GT-fitted weights or widths.

next_action: Do not use scalar sigma as the missing P05/P08 copy-validity probability. Bind unique-source observations and competing geometry to the same conditional evidence; C3 predictive residual calibration can then remain a nuisance component of that law. No second source edit while source-identity validation is pending.
